component.name: Gitree
component.summary: Visual Git client inspired by a source control tool on macOS

description.p: Gitree is a native GNOME Git client inspired by a source control tool on macOS: a repository browser, a commit graph, hunk and line staging, and dialogs for every everyday Git operation.

ul.li: Commit history with branch graph, search and file log
Stage, unstage and discard files, hunks or individual lines
Pull, push, fetch, branch, merge, rebase, stash, tag and cherry-pick
Interactive rebase, conflict resolution and blame
Git-flow, Git LFS, submodules and subtrees
